name: smwgraphics-spooky-outside
title: Spooky Outside
description:
So, you were looking for a nice, semi-3D and spooky foreground, eh? You don't need to search for it anymore! I originally made if for my haunted level for the Halloween contest, but as I dropped out the contest, I decided to release the foreground of the outside part of my level. It uses palette 2, as my other foregrounds. Insert it as FG3.

Credit isn't necessary, but it'd be nice. Enjoy!
